# kion_category (Resource)

Manages a Kion Category.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_category" "example" {
  # Required
  name = "example"

  # Optional
  # description = "example"
  # payer_id    = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Category name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Category description.
- `payer_id` (Number) Payer ID of related Payer of the category in the application.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Category ID.
